name: Iris Corona
author: E. T. Carter
description: A breathing iris ringed by a corona of wavering radial flame tongues. A soft luminous pupil sits at the centre and out of it licks a crown of thick tapering tongues whose tips waver and flicker on their own phases, like a slow solar corona seen edge on. Colour blends cyclically through the palette by angle. Fatter and softer than the thin-ray burst and hair-strand fila siblings, the whole crown drifts and pulses as if alive, scaling to fill the frame.

params.label: Tongues
params.effect: Number of flame tongues in the crown — a few broad licks at the low end, a dense flickering corona at the high end.

params.label: Reach
params.effect: Base length of the tongues in CSS pixels before the size multiplier — pair with Size to set how far the crown licks out.

params.label: Waver
params.effect: How much the tips waver, flicker and pulse in length — still petals at 0, a restless living flame at 1.

params.label: Pupil
params.effect: Radius of the luminous pupil at the centre, from a tight bright point to a wide soft glow the tongues spring from.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Glow strength of the corona and core — a dim ember at 0, a blazing crown at 1.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Rotation and shimmer speed of the whole crown — nearly fixed at 0, slowly turning at full.

params.label: Hue turn
params.effect: How many times the colour wheel turns around the circle — a single tinted crown near 0, a full rainbow corona at the high end.

params.label: Size
params.effect: Overall scale of the corona — a small medallion in the centre at the low end, tongues reaching past the corners to fill the frame at the high end.
